The shape that was uninterrupted in the input becomes interrupted in the output, and vice versa. It is like the shapes that are "on top" and "under" swap places in the output, depending on whether it is interrupted, or uninterrupted. I've validated this through examples 1 and 2 and I'm eager to dig for counterexamples to refine the rule.
